'''November 2001 Bochum tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Bochum, Germany in November 2001. It is known from Bastian Winkelhaus's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3114">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ the-circle-is-now-complete], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 23 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' November 2001
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
